front.title: Applicability of Autonomic Networking Ecosystem to 6G AI-Network Integration

abstract.t: This draft starts with AI-agents, AI-Agent network (AAN) and various types of AAN realization models. It elucidates two 6G network-AI intergrated issues, with the focuse on the aspect of the 6G AI-for- network. The 6G architecture defines two core intelligent AI-agents that can be categorized as the AI-powered autonomic service agent or AI-ASA in the context of the ANIMA domain. Based on the reference model and constituent entities of the autonomic networking ecosystem, the ANIMA model is applied to correlate the mattered 6G entities with different components of the ANIMA ecosystem.
